snippet.title: Project Luminext 0.1.0.2 Showcase (Lumines Fan Game)
snippet.description:
Project Luminext is a new, high-quality Lumines fan project developed by UnfavorableEnhancer aka Revenant. It closely recreates the gameplay of the series while also introducing new features and twists of its own, such as the ability to create your own skin mods with the in-game Skin Editor.

This video showcases the four skins that currently come with the game, the Time Attack mode and the Synesthesia mode, in which you can load your own audio files and use them as background music.

The game is available for download here: https://github.com/UnfavorableEnhancer/Project-Luminext/releases

Please note that since the game is still in active development, everything shown here is subject to change. Report any bugs or issues to the project repository on GitHub; I will not be able to help you troubleshoot them!
